Voatdev

Last week in /v/voatdev began with another report about "unreadable messages" -- that is to say, message notifications that seemingly cannot be cleared. Every time this has ever been reported, to my knowledge, the issue has been unread messages deeper in the inbox history (on page two, for instance). This happens when someone makes a submission that gets so many replies that more than one page of the inbox history fills up before the user checks their inbox. The inbox right now automatically sends users to page one, instead of the page with the farthest back unread messages. As a result, the first page of notifications will be read, but those on later pages will not be read. When a user revisits the homepage and sees that he or she still has unread messages, he or she will click again on the red envelope -- but there won't be any messages! This because they are again sent to page one instead of the farthest back page. Let this be a record for those who read Voat News -- if you ever have unreadable notifications, just look farther back. Ideally the inbox feature will be fixed so this stops happening to people (by sending users to the farthest back unread notification, for example).
